# M0-S1 secondary: a dependency with a newer go version reaches the
# toolchain Switcher during module loading, bypassing Select's logos early
# return. Logos mode must report the too-new dependency without switching.
#
# Fixture: the main module stays at the current version so Select sees no
# startup switch; only dep/go.mod (wired in with a local replace) requires
# go 1.99, so the TooNew surfaces through the Switcher while loading deps.
# Offline (GOPROXY=off) a switch attempt fails in NewerToolchain and the
# Switcher reports `switching to go >= ...` (switch.go).

env GOTOOLCHAIN=auto
env GOPROXY=off

# Logos mode: too-new dependency errors without switching.
! logos mod tidy
stderr 'requires go >= 1\.99'
! stderr 'switching to'

# Plain-go control: the same module attempts a switch (upstream intact).
! go mod tidy
stderr 'switching to go >= 1\.99'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/toolchaincheck

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ./dep

-- main.go --
package main

import _ "example.com/dep"

func main() {}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.99

-- dep/dep.go --
package dep
